subject.title: feat: add sanitized test environment seeding

question: Should production-derived test snapshots be limited to rows that are public-listable under the current package and skill visibility predicates, or may the test deployment intentionally include a broader hidden corpus?
rationale: The PR creates a production-snapshot-to-test data boundary, and the current sanitizer admits rows that the live product treats as not public-listable; that is a maintainer/security policy choice beyond CI.

options.title: Fix to public-listable only
options.body: Require package and skill snapshot selection to reuse or mirror current public visibility predicates, add failed/pending/not-run regression tests, and merge after final import proof.

options.title: Approve broader corpus
options.body: Document that the test deployment may contain production-derived rows hidden from public browse, then accept the extra security and operator-review burden.

options.title: Hold the draft
options.body: Keep this PR in draft until the full sanitized baseline import completes and a maintainer can review the redacted validation output.

recommendation.title: Fix to public-listable only
recommendation.body: Require package and skill snapshot selection to reuse or mirror current public visibility predicates, add failed/pending/not-run regression tests, and merge after final import proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent dev-seeding, preview-seeding, and scan-policy history that this production-derived test seeding workflow extends.
